The equation t2−14t+5=5 can be written in the form (t+p)2=q. Find pq, and the sum of the roots t1+t2.

a
 pq=−343 and t1+t2=14
b
 pq=−14 and t1+t2=49
c
 pq=−264 and t1+t2=−14
d
 pq=343 and t1+t2=−14
e
 pq=−343 and t1+t2=−14
